gallery.eyebrow: A little space for your music
gallery.heading: Quietly, beautifully musical.
gallery.intro: Warm surfaces, soft violet, room to breathe. Meet the small details that will shape your Musiclatte space.
gallery.foundationNote: A quiet palette and clear type, leaving the spotlight to your music.
gallery.actionNote: Give the main action a clear voice. Try a button to see its response.
gallery.longAction: Add all music in the selected folder to the current playlist
gallery.feedbackIdle: Your action feedback will appear here.
gallery.feedbackDone: Action received. Your music stays unchanged.
gallery.iconNote: Small in appearance, comfortable to press. Every icon has an accessible name.
gallery.fieldNote: Labels stay visible. Help and errors stay close to the field.
gallery.help: Enter the name you use on your music server. Longer guidance stays readable without hiding any information.
gallery.fieldError: We could not find that name. Check the spelling and enter it again.
gallery.stateNote: A clear next step, through waiting, empty spaces, and errors.
gallery.loadingDescription: Your library is on its way. The music you are listening to keeps playing.
gallery.emptyDescription: Choose another folder to find something you love.
gallery.errorTitle: This folder could not be loaded
gallery.errorDescription: Check your connection and try again. Music already loaded is still available.
gallery.recoveredDescription: Your music is ready to explore again.
gallery.artwork: A little face for your music
gallery.artworkNote: The same space, even when a cover is loading or missing.
gallery.coverAlt: A little afternoon playlist album cover
gallery.footer: Real shared components · Development preview only
login.title: Welcome back
login.description: Sign in to your music space.
login.expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
playlists.title: Playlists
playlists.description: Choose a playlist to see its songs or start listening in order.
playlists.loadingHelp: Your playlists are on their way. Current playback is unchanged.
playlists.emptyHelp: Create a playlist here, then add music whenever you are ready.
playlists.detailEmptyHelp: Add songs in Musiclatte, then return here to listen in order.
playlists.notFoundHelp: This playlist was removed or is no longer available. Return to your playlists.
playlists.deniedHelp: Your account cannot open this playlist. Return to a playlist you can access.
playlists.unavailableHelp: Playlists are not available for this account right now.
playlists.nameHelp: Use 1–255 characters. Spaces at the beginning and end are removed; symbols are kept.
playlists.nameInvalid: Check the name and try again.
playlists.deleteImpact: Only this playlist is deleted. Its songs and audio files are kept.
playlists.conflict: This playlist changed elsewhere. The latest version is shown behind this dialog.
playlists.outcomeUnknown: The result could not be confirmed. Refresh the playlist before trying again.
playlists.removeContext: Remove {title} at position {position} from this playlist? The song and audio file are kept.
playlists.editConflict: This playlist changed elsewhere. The latest version is shown below.
settings.languageHelp: Changing language keeps your current page and sign-in.
status.unavailableHelp: There is no available feature at this address.
status.capability: Some feature information is unavailable. Your account and language settings are still available.
error.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
error.csrf_rejected: Your sign-in changed. Please try again.
error.invalid_request: Check your details and try again.
error.token_auth_unsupported: This server does not support this sign-in method. Contact your server administrator.
error.upstream_unavailable: Cannot reach the server. Please try again shortly.
error.storage_unavailable: Cannot check your session. Please try again shortly.
error.internal_error: Could not complete your request. Please try again.
error.upstream_incompatible: The music server API version is incompatible.
error.conflict: This playlist changed. Refresh it before trying again.
